reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Activity under preparation Strategic Communication Facility

description.narrative: The action will continue the support of implementation of strategic communication activities designed to raise awareness, understanding and perception of the European Union and its partnership within the Caribbean Region, in line with the identified priorities in the Americas and the Caribbean Regional Multiannual Indicative Programme as well as Global Gateway.The action will also reflect the full regional scope of the Caribbean, including the Overseas Countries and Territories. This will require the capacity to develop and deliver campaigns across multiple linguistic and cultural contexts, including English, Spanish, French and Dutch, and, where relevant, creoles and other local languages.This action will align with the integrated approach to communication in the EU¿s external action, supporting audience-first, data-driven campaigns. In doing so, the action will help reduce fragmentation, strengthen message coherence, and support more compelling narratives on the EU¿s partnership with the Caribbean region ¿ narratives that are relevant, accessible and responsive to target audiences.The Strategic Communication Facility will increase the resources available for communication campaigns around the Global Gateway Investment Agenda (GGIA) in the region, increasing the potential to give visibility to the EU and European investments across the region.The Overall Objective of this action is to position the EU as a partner of reference for the Caribbean Region among selected audiences. The Specific Objective (Outcome) is to measurably increase awareness, understanding and perception of the EU as a trusted partner on key priorities, in particular those under the Global Gateway strategy.The Outputs to be delivered by this action contributing to the corresponding Specific Objectives (Outcomes): large-scale public campaigns and targeted political communication activities are implemented to make the EU¿s brand positioning more understandable, visible and influential to target audiences.
